description: In April 1887, Lidia's fight reaches Parliament as Enrico gets her reform bill before committee, but a murder case puts the argument into brutally personal form. Her closest friend Grazia Fontana is accused of killing an abusive husband, with Fourneau prosecuting and Lidia helping the defense before an all-male jury. Jacopo returns to Turin to cover the trial, forcing Lidia to navigate the landmark self-defense case, her divided loyalties between Fourneau and Jacopo, and the question of whether law can recognize violence endured inside marriage.

s03e01.description: A trapeze artist is found dead at a circus, and Lidia discovers that the killing grew out of rivalry and a desperate attempt by the victim's closest friend to stop her leaving. At the same time, Lidia's friend Grazia Fontana arrives with her daughter Mila after fleeing an abusive husband; when Guido Fontana is found dead, Grazia becomes the center of a second and far more personal case.

s03e02.description: Grazia is jailed for Guido's death while Lidia and Enrico begin building a self-defense argument around the injuries she endured. A separate murder draws them to painter Luigi, whose relationship with the dead man and involvement in an art fraud force him to protect both his private life and someone else responsible for the crime.

s03e03.description: A telegram suggesting that Grazia invited Guido to meet her damages the defense just as Fourneau finds gaps in her account. Lidia and Jacopo investigate the murder of boxer Nino, where a witness reveals that his manager killed him after Nino threatened to expose fixed fights, while the discovery that Mila sent the telegram further complicates Grazia's trial.

s03e04.description: Doctor Tulio Munnari is due to testify about Grazia's injuries when he is arrested for murdering his sister Eloisa. Lidia and Enrico trace Eloisa's stalking complaint to Bottini and discover that Tulio's wife ordered the killing; Tulio is freed, but Fourneau damages his value as a witness by exposing his affair with Grazia.

s03e05.description: Press coverage of Lidia's relationship with Fourneau strains her partnership with Enrico while fourteen-year-old Berto is accused of murdering his teacher, Borromei. Lidia discovers that the killer is the parent of another boy at the school, then ends her relationship with Fourneau as the Grazia case and Jacopo's future with Consuelo push her personal life apart.

s03e06.description: Lidia and Jacopo search the Fontana estate for evidence and uncover the remains of Amira, an Eritrean woman whom Guido had held as a sexual slave and killed. The discovery gives the defense the context it needs and Grazia is acquitted; afterward Consuelo leaves Jacopo, while Lidia and Jacopo finally acknowledge that their attachment has survived every attempt to move on.
